svg.title: Skill Localization and Customization for Local BUs
svg.desc: A transparent 4200 by 2000 English-language diagram in a rose palette. The Group Skill Baseline is forked with source-version tracking, localized as a complete Skill Package, validated and approved, and published as a version for Local BU Agents. Eight customization areas cover purpose and triggers, inputs and context, language and scenarios, knowledge and business rules, workflow and exceptions, outputs and templates, tools and executable helpers, and tests and evaluation. SKILL.md, references, assets, scripts, and tests form the baseline package. Input-output contract compatibility, versioned breaking changes, calling-Agent tests, runtime authorization, controlled upgrades and rollback are explicit. Rehearse Client Conversation illustrates local language, approved product guidance, playbook and evaluation changes, with optional rehearsal and a clear distinction between client facts, assumptions and simulations.
